title: ANCLINE ERP Completion Build
objective: Finalize the already-built ANCLINE Global Forwarding ERP by making existing pages and approved flows fully functional, consistent and end-to-end complete. Do not create new pages, modules, routes or business flows.
scope: harden and complete existing ERP pages only
make existing screens follow the approved end-to-end business flow
repair broken or missing actions inside existing pages
repair existing navigation, links, buttons and same-page workflows
complete existing form validation and field behavior
bind existing screens to authoritative existing APIs
remove duplicated or conflicting behavior where verified
run realistic cross-module transaction validation using existing approved jobs
fix verified in-scope functional, UI, data-integrity and workflow defects
prepare final acceptance and freeze when all existing flows pass
invariants: preserve existing data model unless an additive fix is strictly required for an already-approved function
preserve API contracts unless an additive compatibility fix is strictly required
preserve maker-checker, four-eyes, segregation-of-duties and audit controls
impact-based tests during development and one final full UAT at the end
finalizationRule: No new pages or flows. Existing approved ERP only: harden, connect, validate, full UAT, final freeze.
